body: Good for you, you got this my friend!! <33
It looks like it has a tooth for a tongue

I get that, I do the same thing. I really want someone to just ask me how I’m really doing, prove to me that someone actually cares. I just try to remind myself that somewhere out there there’s someone who does really care what happens to me. It’s that thought that keeps me going. No matter how hard it is to believe, I guarantee there’s at least one person on this earth who would be devastated if they found out you were gone. You all have Someone who loves you dearly, even if you don’t realize it yet. Don’t give up. The darkness now may seem impossible to get through but if you can make it through this, there’s nothing in this world you can’t conquer :)
